title.en: UN ends 35-year Western Sahara peacekeeping mission as MINURSO mandate lapses
title.zh_hant: 聯合國西撒哈拉維和任務結束35年使命　古特雷斯重申撒哈拉人民自決權
title.zh_hans: 联合国西撒哈拉维和任务结束35年使命　古特雷斯重申撒哈拉人民自决权

summary.en: The UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) has ended after 35 years, with its mandate expiring at midnight on Saturday. The Security Council failed on Friday to agree on an extension: a US-drafted resolution was vetoed by Russia, while a rival Russian text did not win enough votes. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres stressed that the withdrawal does not abrogate the Sahrawi people's inalienable right to self-determination, and said the UN will keep pursuing a political solution through his personal envoy. Morocco's Royal Court called the 35-year chapter closed.
summary.zh_hant: 聯合國駐西撒哈拉全民投票特派團（MINURSO）嘅授權喺上周六午夜屆滿，35年維和任務正式結束。安理會上周五未能就延續授權達成共識：美國提出嘅決議草案被俄羅斯否決，俄羅斯自己嘅草案亦未獲足夠票數通過。秘書長古特雷斯強調，維和人員撤走唔等於撒哈拉人民失去不可剝奪嘅自決權，聯合國會繼續透過特使推動政治解決。摩洛哥王室就話，35年嘅一頁已經揭過。
summary.zh_hans: 联合国驻西撒哈拉全民投票特派团（MINURSO）的授权在上周六午夜届满，35年维和任务正式结束。安理会上周五未能就延续授权达成共识：美国提出的决议草案被俄罗斯否决，俄罗斯自己的草案亦未获足够票数通过。秘书长古特雷斯强调，维和人员撤走不等于撒哈拉人民失去不可剥夺的自决权，联合国会继续透过特使推动政治解决。摩洛哥王室则说，35年的一页已经揭过。

title.en: Bulgaria exit polls point to Yotova win in presidential runoff
title.zh_hant: 保加利亞總統決選出口民調：約廷諾娃料52%勝出　成首位民選女總統
title.zh_hans: 保加利亚总统决选出口民调：约廷诺娃料52%胜出　成首位民选女总统

summary.en: Exit polls in Bulgaria suggest acting President Iliana Yotova is the likely winner of Sunday's presidential runoff, with around 52 percent of the vote against about 44 percent for former caretaker prime minister Andrey Gyurov. If confirmed, the 62-year-old would become Bulgaria's first elected female head of state. Neither candidate secured a majority in the first round on October 25, which drew a record-low turnout of about 23 percent. Official results are expected on Monday. Exit polls by BNR and Alpha Research put Yotova at 51 to 52.5 percent, and preliminary counting of about 75 percent of ballots, reported by BGNES, gives her 56.1 percent against 39.9 percent for Andrey Gyurov, with turnout around 29 percent.
summary.zh_hant: 保加利亞周日舉行總統決選，多間民調機構嘅出口民調顯示，現任總統約廷諾娃有望以約52%得票率擊敗前看守總理古羅夫。如果結果得到確認，62歲嘅約廷諾娃將成為保加利亞首位民選女總統。10月25日首輪投票兩人都未能過半數，投票率僅約23%創歷史新低。官方結果預計周一公布。官方廣播電台 BNR 同 Alpha Research 嘅出口民調分別顯示約廷諾娃得票 51% 同 52.5%；保加利亞通訊社 BGNES 引述初步計票（已點約 75% 選票）話，約廷諾娃得票 56.1%，領先居羅夫嘅 39.9%，投票率約 29%。
summary.zh_hans: 保加利亚周日举行总统决选，多间民调机构的出口民调显示，现任总统约廷诺娃有望以约52%得票率击败前看守总理古罗夫。如果结果得到确认，62岁的约廷诺娃将成为保加利亚首位民选女总统。10月25日首轮投票两人都未能过半数，投票率仅约23%创历史新低。官方结果预计周一公布。官方广播电台 BNR 和 Alpha Research 的出口民调分别显示约廷诺娃得票 51% 和 52.5%；保加利亚通讯社 BGNES 引述初步计票（已点约 75% 选票）说，约廷诺娃得票 56.1%，领先居罗夫的 39.9%，投票率约 29%。

title.en: Pope hopes Oleshky truce cooperation can spur Ukraine-Russia peace
title.zh_hant: 教宗：盼奧列什基停火合作帶動烏俄和平進程
title.zh_hans: 教宗：盼奥列什基停火合作带动乌俄和平进程

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV said on Sunday he hopes the cooperation shown by Russia and Ukraine in implementing a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky will pave the way for broader peace efforts. The two sides agreed on October 23 to a six-day humanitarian truce, brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump with the involvement of the Pope, to allow aid deliveries and civilian evacuations from the frontline town suffering severe shortages. It was the longest local pause in fighting since the full-scale invasion. President Zelenskiy said peace negotiators would meet for fresh talks in early November.
summary.zh_hant: 教宗良十四世周日表示，希望俄烏雙方喺奧列什基實施停火時展現嘅合作，可以為更廣泛嘅和平努力鋪路。俄烏10月23日同意喺俄軍佔領嘅奧列什基停火六日，由美國第一夫人梅拉尼婭居中斡旋、教宗亦有參與，方便向糧食同藥物嚴重短缺嘅前線城鎮運送援助同撤離平民。呢次係俄烏全面開戰以嚟最長嘅局部停火，約2000名平民獲安排撤離或補給。澤連斯基話，和平談判代表將喺11月初再會面。
summary.zh_hans: 教宗良十四世周日表示，希望俄乌双方在奥列什基实施停火时展现的合作，可以为更广泛的和平努力铺路。俄乌10月23日同意在俄军占领的奥列什基停火六日，由美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅居中斡旋、教宗亦有参与，方便向粮食和药物严重短缺的前线城镇运送援助和撤离平民。这次是俄乌全面开战以来最长的局部停火，约2000名平民获安排撤离或补给。泽连斯基说，和平谈判代表将在11月初再会面。

title.en: Iran's supreme leader orders immediate, geographically unrestricted response to any new US-Israeli attack
title.zh_hant: 伊朗最高領袖下令：美以若再動武　即時無地域限制反擊
title.zh_hans: 伊朗最高领袖下令：美以若再动武　即时无地域限制反击

summary.en: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has ordered the armed forces to meet any renewed US or Israeli military or terrorist attack with an immediate and effective response without geographical restrictions. Meeting senior commanders, he also instructed the military to update its list of potential targets to cover all kinds of American and Israeli assets, physical and non-physical. The statement said that if enemies resume attacks, it will be Iran that determines when and under what conditions they end. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that President Trump had not yet decided on new strikes against Iran.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗最高領袖哈梅內伊會見三軍高級將領，下令如果美國或以色列再次發動軍事或恐怖襲擊，伊朗武裝部隊必須即時作出有效回應，而且唔設地域限制。佢同時要求軍方更新打擊目標清單，涵蓋美以兩國各類有形同無形資產。聲明又話，如果敵人重啟戰事，幾時同點樣結束將由伊朗話事。美國國務卿魯比奧周六話，特朗普未決定係咪再打擊伊朗。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊会见三军高级将领，下令如果美国或以色列再次发动军事或恐怖袭击，伊朗武装部队必须即时作出有效回应，而且不设地域限制。他同时要求军方更新打击目标清单，涵盖美以两国各类有形和无形资产。声明又说，如果敌人重启战事，何时和怎样结束将由伊朗话事。美国国务卿鲁比奥周六说，特朗普未决定是否再打击伊朗。

title.en: John Lee: Hong Kong to become international I&T hub after 2030; over 120 firms in Lok Ma Chau Loop
title.zh_hant: 李家超：2030年後基本建成國際創科中心　河套逾120機構進駐
title.zh_hans: 李家超：2030年后基本建成国际创科中心　河套逾120机构进驻

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee said in a video speech at the opening of the 2026 Greater Bay Area Science Forum on Saturday that Hong Kong will, under its first five-year plan published in September, basically become an international innovation and technology centre after 2030. He revealed that more than 120 I&T enterprises and organisations have set up in the Hong Kong Park of the Lok Ma Chau Loop, up from over 100 when the Policy Address was delivered. The government also plans to step up new industrialisation and research commercialisation cooperation with Guangdong and Shenzhen. The San Tin Technopole will provide about 210 hectares of I&T land to complement the Loop.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超周六喺2026大灣區科學論壇開幕式發表視像致辭，話香港會按今年9月公布嘅首份五年規劃，喺2030年後基本建成國際創新科技中心。佢透露，河套香港園區已有超過120間創科企業同機構進駐，較施政報告公布時嘅逾100間再有增加。政府亦計劃同廣東省及深圳市加強新型工業同科研成果轉化合作。新田科技城就會提供約210公頃創科用地，同河套分工發展。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超周六在2026大湾区科学论坛开幕式发表视频致辞，说香港会按今年9月公布的首份五年规划，在2030年后基本建成国际创新科技中心。他透露，河套香港园区已有超过120间创科企业和机构进驻，较施政报告公布时的逾100间再有增加。政府亦计划和广东省及深圳市加强新型工业和科研成果转化合作。新田科技城就会提供约210公顷创科用地，和河套分工发展。

title.en: 131,000 mainland visitors enter Hong Kong on Halloween eve as city celebrates
title.zh_hant: 萬聖節前夜13.1萬內地客入境　蘭桂坊冀生意增五成
title.zh_hans: 万圣节前夜13.1万内地客入境　兰桂坊冀生意增五成

summary.en: About 131,000 mainland visitors entered Hong Kong on Halloween eve, according to immigration figures, as a mega concert was held at Kai Tak Stadium on the night of October 30 and Halloween events took place across the city. The Tourism Board's first-ever Hong Kong Halloween Month has spread festivities from the traditional Lan Kwai Fong to Mong Kok, Kai Tak and other districts. With Halloween itself falling on a Saturday, the whole city plunged into celebration from the evening, and Lan Kwai Fong businesses hope turnover will rise 50 percent year on year.
summary.zh_hant: 入境處數字顯示，萬聖節前夜約13.1萬人次內地旅客入境香港；啟德主場館10月30日晚舉行大型演唱會，全港多區亦有萬聖節活動。今年旅發局首辦「香港萬聖月」，將節慶由傳統嘅蘭桂坊擴散到旺角、啟德等區。適逢萬聖節正日係星期六，全城由傍晚開始進入狂歡狀態，蘭桂坊業界期望生意按年增加五成。
summary.zh_hans: 入境处数字显示，万圣节前夜约13.1万人次内地旅客入境香港；启德主场馆10月30日晚举行大型演唱会，全港多区亦有万圣节活动。今年旅发局首办「香港万圣月」，将节庆由传统的兰桂坊扩散到旺角、启德等区。适逢万圣节正日是星期六，全城由傍晚开始进入狂欢状态，兰桂坊业界期望生意按年增加五成。

title.en: Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 opens with 45,000 expected from 120 economies
title.zh_hant: 香港金融科技周今日開幕　逾45,000人聚會展　聚焦金融+、AI+
title.zh_hans: 香港金融科技周今日开幕　逾45,000人聚会展　聚焦金融+、AI+

summary.en: Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 opened on Sunday, running through November 6 with the main forum held at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on November 2 and 3. Organised by the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau and InvestHK, the five-day event is expected to draw more than 45,000 participants from over 120 economies, alongside 1,000-plus speakers and 800 exhibitors and startups. This year's theme, 'Fintech Nexus: Bridging the World, Building the Future', is built around three growth engines — Finance+, AI+ and global expansion — with 10 dedicated forums on AI, digital assets, Web3, green tech and more. The government said it will announce new measures on AI application and governance, tokenisation and payment connectivity during the week.
summary.zh_hant: 香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026 今日正式開幕，一連五日去到 11 月 6 日，主論壇今明兩日喺灣仔會展舉行。活動由財經事務及庫務局、商務及經濟發展局同投資推廣署主辦，預計吸引嚟自超過 120 個經濟體、逾 45,000 人參與，演講嘉賓超過 1,000 人，參展機構同初創企業超過 800 家。今屆主題係「金融科技樞紐 聯通世界 共建未來」，議程圍繞三大增長引擎「金融+」、「AI+」同全球拓展，設 10 個專題論壇，涵蓋 AI、數字資產、Web3、綠色科技等範疇。政府話，活動期間會圍繞人工智能應用同治理、代幣化、支付互聯等領域公布一系列新措施。
summary.zh_hans: 香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 2026 今日正式开幕，一连五日到 11 月 6 日，主论坛今明两日在湾仔会展举行。活动由财经事务及库务局、商务及经济发展局和投资推广署主办，预计吸引来自超过 120 个经济体、逾 45,000 人参与，演讲嘉宾超过 1,000 人，参展机构和初创企业超过 800 家。今届主题是「金融科技枢纽 联通世界 共建未来」，议程围绕三大增长引擎「金融+」、「AI+」和全球拓展，设 10 个专题论坛，涵盖 AI、数字资产、Web3、绿色科技等范畴。政府说，活动期间会围绕人工智能应用和治理、代币化、支付互联等领域公布一系列新措施。

title.en: Iran: Strait of Hormuz could reopen in 48 hours if deal reached with US
title.zh_hant: 伊朗：若美伊達成協議　荷姆茲海峽48小時內可重開
title.zh_hans: 伊朗：若美伊达成协议　荷姆兹海峡48小时内可重开

summary.en: Iran's foreign minister told Al Jazeera that if Tehran reaches an agreement with Washington, the Strait of Hormuz could be reopened within two days. Iranian and Qatari mediators have held a third day of talks in Doha aimed at ending the US-Israeli war against Iran, discussing what he called a 'two-day proposal'. Iran's conditions include lifting new sanctions, reducing the US military presence in the region, restoring oil waivers and releasing frozen assets. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that Washington prefers a diplomatic solution.
summary.zh_hant: 伊朗外長阿拉格齊接受半島電視台訪問時話，如果德黑蘭同華府達成協議，荷姆茲海峽可以喺兩日內重開。伊朗同卡達調解代表喺杜哈進行第三日會談，推動結束美以對伊朗嘅戰爭，雙方正討論所謂「兩天提案」。伊朗開出嘅條件包括解除新增制裁、減少美軍喺區內部署、恢復石油豁免同釋放被凍結資金。美國國務卿魯比奧周六話，美方傾向用外交方式解決。
summary.zh_hans: 伊朗外长阿拉格齐接受半岛电视台访问时说，如果德黑兰和华府达成协议，荷姆兹海峡可以在两日内重开。伊朗和卡达调解代表在杜哈进行第三日会谈，推动结束美以对伊朗的战争，双方正讨论所谓「两天提案」。伊朗开出的条件包括解除新增制裁、减少美军在区内部署、恢复石油豁免和释放被冻结资金。美国国务卿鲁比奥周六说，美方倾向用外交方式解决。

title.en: Israeli airstrikes kill at least 8 in Gaza; 1,580 dead since October ceasefire
title.zh_hant: 以軍空襲加沙致至少8死　停火以來累計1,580人喪生
title.zh_hans: 以军空袭加沙致至少8死　停火以来累计1,580人丧生

summary.en: Israeli forces carried out airstrikes across Gaza on Saturday, killing at least eight people and injuring several others, according to Palestinian news agency reports. A drone strike in Khan Younis killed five policemen, while an attack in western Gaza City killed three people, including a child. Gaza health authorities said 1,580 people have been killed and 5,711 injured since the ceasefire took effect on October 10, 2025.
summary.zh_hant: 巴勒斯坦通訊社11月1日報道，以軍當日對加沙多地發動空襲，至少8人死亡、多人受傷。汗尤尼斯一宗無人機襲擊造成5名警察死亡，加沙城西部一地遇襲，3人死亡包括一名兒童。加沙衛生部門話，自2025年10月10日停火以嚟，已有1,580人死亡、5,711人受傷。
summary.zh_hans: 巴勒斯坦通讯社11月1日报道，以军当日对加沙多地发动空袭，至少8人死亡、多人受伤。汗尤尼斯一宗无人机袭击造成5名警察死亡，加沙城西部一地遇袭，3人死亡包括一名儿童。加沙卫生部门说，自2025年10月10日停火以来，已有1,580人死亡、5,711人受伤。

title.en: Nicholas Tse hit by glow stick thrown from crowd at Wenzhou concert, carries on
title.zh_hant: 謝霆鋒溫州演唱會被觀眾掟熒光棒砸中腿部　笑住繼續唱
title.zh_hans: 谢霆锋温州演唱会被观众扔荧光棒砸中腿部　笑着继续唱

summary.en: Nicholas Tse was hit in the leg by a glow stick thrown from the stands during his 'Evolution' concert at the Wenzhou Olympic Sports Centre on October 31. A man in white reportedly hurled the light stick while Tse was performing on an extended mechanical stage. The singer did not stop or pursue the matter, smiling and continuing the show; when confronted by fans, the man claimed he threw it out of genuine admiration, a claim many netizens rejected as an excuse.
summary.zh_hant: 10月31日謝霆鋒喺溫州奧體中心「進化」演唱會演出期間，被一名白衣男子從看台掟出嘅熒光棒擊中腿部。當時謝霆鋒正喺伸出嘅機械臂舞台上唱歌，佢冇停低追究，溫柔一笑繼續演出。該男子被現場歌迷質問時，辯稱係「發自內心喜歡」先扔，唔少網民唔收貨，視為狡辯，要求嚴懲。
summary.zh_hans: 10月31日谢霆锋在温州奥体中心「进化」演唱会演出期间，被一名白衣男子从看台扔出的荧光棒击中腿部。当时谢霆锋正在伸出的机械臂舞台上唱歌，他没有停下追究，温柔一笑继续演出。该男子被现场歌迷质问时，辩称是「发自内心喜欢」才扔，不少网民不买账，视为狡辩，要求严惩。

title.en: Wakin Chau announces he is about to become a grandfather at Jinan concert
title.zh_hant: 周華健濟南演唱會宣布「要當爺爺了」　笑言改歌名《親親我的孫兒寶貝》
title.zh_hans: 周华健济南演唱会宣布「要当爷爷了」　笑言改歌名《亲亲我的孙儿宝贝》

summary.en: Wakin Chau surprised fans at his Jinan concert on the evening of October 31 by announcing that he is about to become a grandfather. Before singing 'My Dearest Baby', he shared the story behind the song, written for his son Andrew, and said he now plans to rename it 'My Dearest Grandchild Baby'. China Performance Industry Association data showed large-scale commercial performances grossed 17.111 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, up 17.7 percent year on year.
summary.zh_hant: 10月31日晚周華健喺濟南演唱會上，喺唱《親親我的寶貝》之前同歌迷分享喜訊，宣布自己即將當爺爺。佢話首歌當年係寫畀兒子周厚安，而家兒子大咗，笑言要將歌名改做《親親我的孫兒寶貝》。同場公布嘅中國演出行業協會數據顯示，2026年上半年5,000人以上大型營業性演出票房達171.11億元人民幣，按年增長17.7%。
summary.zh_hans: 10月31日晚周华健在济南演唱会上，在唱《亲亲我的宝贝》之前和歌迷分享喜讯，宣布自己即将当爷爷。他说首歌当年是写给儿子周厚安，如今儿子大了，笑言要将歌名改做《亲亲我的孙儿宝贝》。同场公布的中国演出行业协会数据显示，2026年上半年5,000人以上大型营业性演出票房达171.11亿元人民币，按年增长17.7%。
